If such a model does not exists, is there any proof that relevant to the fact that there is no subtopos of Sets which is a model of ETCS?

#6 I think maybe we have hope for a model with cardinality ∣P(N)∣|P( N)|∣P(N)∣? I feel the following might works, but very artificial.

Take the subcategory of Sets whose set of object is ∣P(N)∣| P( N)|∣P(N)∣. Arrows are all the arrows between these sets in Sets but exclude all the functions from any infinite set, except for the successor function N→NN\to NN→N.

We know that there is a bijection N×N→NN\times N \to NN×N→N, call this function npair\mathrm{npair}npair. Inductively, this bijection gives a bijection from list of natural numbers to N NN, call this function nlist\mathrm{nlist}nlist.

If p∈Np\in Np∈N is a natural number that encodes a pair, that is, p=npair(a,b)p = \mathrm{npair}(a,b)p=npair(a,b) for some a,b∈Na,b\in Na,b∈N, then nfst(p)=a,nsnd(p)=b\mathrm{nfst}(p) =a,\mathrm{nsnd}(p) = bnfst(p)=a,nsnd(p)=b.

If l∈Nl\in Nl∈N is a natural number that encodes a list, then nel(n,l)∈N\mathrm{nel}(n,l)\in Nnel(n,l)∈N is the nnn-th element of this list.

Then we can encode pairs of natural numbers as natural numbers, so the usual construction of product/pullback in Sets can be turned into a set of natural numbers. Also exponentials, which are sets of functions, can be encoded as a natural number.

It is not obvious to me if capturing pairs and functions by natural numbers and excluding these functions with infinite domain makes some axioms unsatisfied already.

content: #7 ZFC can prove BZC consistent, since Vω+ωV_{\omega+\omega}Vω+ω​ is a model of the latter, and is a set of the former. Since ETCS is about the same as BZC, since means that ZFC can prove that ETCS has a model. But if your background material set theory is BZC, then you cannot prove there is a model of ETCS, else BZC would be able to prove a model of itself exists, and this is not allowed by Gödel incompleteness.
